parameters.jsCode:
// 12 knowledge-base entries simulating documents pulled from FAQ, help docs, and policy files
const entries = [
  { id: 'kb-001', title: 'What is Petalnex?', category: 'Company', source: 'faq.md', content: 'Petalnex Pvt. Ltd. is an AI automation company that builds intelligent workflow solutions for businesses of all sizes.' },
  { id: 'kb-002', title: 'Business Hours', category: 'Support', source: 'faq.md', content: 'Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM (PKT). Weekend requests are answered on the next business day.' },
  { id: 'kb-003', title: 'How to reset your password', category: 'Account', source: 'help.txt', content: 'To reset your password, click "Forgot Password" on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the link sent to your inbox.' },
  { id: 'kb-004', title: 'Supported vector databases', category: 'Product', source: 'docs.md', content: 'Our platform supports Supabase Vector, Qdrant, and Pinecone as vector store backends. All three offer generous free tiers for prototyping.' },
  { id: 'kb-005', title: 'What are embeddings?', category: 'Concepts', source: 'glossary.txt', content: 'Embeddings are numerical vector representations of text that capture semantic meaning, enabling similarity search and retrieval augmented generation.' },
  { id: 'kb-006', title: 'Refund policy', category: 'Billing', source: 'policy.pdf', content: 'Customers may request a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.' },
  { id: 'kb-007', title: 'Data privacy commitment', category: 'Legal', source: 'policy.pdf', content: 'We never sell your data. All customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we comply with GDPR and applicable data protection regulations.' },
  { id: 'kb-008', title: 'How chunking works', category: 'Concepts', source: 'docs.md', content: 'Long documents are split into overlapping chunks before embedding so that each chunk fits the model context window and preserves surrounding context.' },
  { id: 'kb-009', title: 'Integrations available', category: 'Product', source: 'docs.md', content: 'Petalnex integrates with Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, and hundreds of other apps through the n8n automation platform.' },
  { id: 'kb-010', title: 'Free trial details', category: 'Billing', source: 'faq.md', content: 'New users get a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card is required to start the trial.' },
  { id: 'kb-011', title: 'Contact support', category: 'Support', source: 'faq.md', content: 'You can reach our support team by emailing support@petalnex.example or by opening a ticket from your account dashboard.' },
  { id: 'kb-012', title: 'What is RAG?', category: 'Concepts', source: 'glossary.txt', content: 'Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a vector search over your knowledge base with a language model so answers are grounded in your own documents.' },
];
return entries.map((e) => ({ json: e }));
